d: In 2024, Novo Nordisk, the maker of the viral weight-loss drug Ozempic did something almost impossible. It became more valuable than the entire country it was born in. With a market capitalization peaking over $630 billion, it dwarfed Denmark’s annual GDP and single-handedly carried the Danish economy. Celebrities, tech billionaires, and millions of patients around the world turned a 100 year old insulin manufacturer into a cultural phenomenon. And then, everything shattered.
